name: What kind of paint should I choose for my living room?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint should I choose for my living room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint for your living room depends on desired finish, durability, and light exposure. Matte or flat finishes hide imperfections well, while eggshell or satin offer a subtle sheen and are more washable. For high-traffic areas, durable paints with a slight sheen are often recommended. We can discuss options like low-VOC paints for better air quality and help you select the best type and finish during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider finish (matte, eggshell, satin), durability, and washability when choosing paint for your living room.
